Kathrin Petersen thank you and yes exactly. We applied online and their response was about a missing Apostille we didn't see. We got 45 days and they extended those already. The German office is not proceeding with the document. so we are kinda stuck waiting to continue. The case is still open.
Because I'm pregnant this is the last window to fly and visit my family. But I also don't want to risk that they close the case or I can't re-enter. So a re-entry visa is also an option with the tourist visa? We will see if that could work for us. Thank you
